patch.value: GH-1591: guarded terminal updates conflict with their own scalar write and misreport compensation

Sequential timestamp-guarded SDK update persists scalar edits, then refuses its own terminal transition as upsert_match_changed while the journal reports compensated. Independently reproduced in an isolated current-build fixture on Node26.12.1.

Matching initial timestamp guard plus scalar edits and terminal transition succeeds without self-conflict; stale starting guards refuse before any item/history writes; internal steps retain lock-held writer safety; partial mutation is truthfully reported or compensated; sequential lifecycle/history/journal regressions cover both success and refusal.
One guarded SDK operation preserves stale-writer protection while accepting its own internal writes and reporting accurate transaction recovery state.
upsert_match_changed exit4 leaves the changed title on an open item with newer updated_at; journal status is compensated with empty started/completed step arrays.
